model.name: Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation.

notes.body:
Model for RAAS system of blood pressure regulation. Enalapril is an inhibitor of ACE, so it inhibits conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II.
components: renin, angiotensinogen, angiotensin I, angiotensin II, ACE, aldosterone, systolic and diastolic blood pressure
blood pressure is regulated directly and only by aldosterone
negative feedback loop: angiotensin II inhibits synthesis of renin
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.
